About Us:

SBM Offshore is the world’s deepwater ocean‑infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise to enable that into the future while at the same time using our expertise to support new and existing markets in the blue economy. It starts with Advancing our Core: continuing to advance the decarbonization of traditional energy production. While Pioneering More: helping to enable the energy transition and using our unique capabilities in ocean infrastructure to support more industries to grow sustainably. Sharing our experience for a better blue tomorrow.

Purpose

  • You are responsible for ensuring the effective integrity of piping systems and pressure vessels on Floating Production Storage and Offloading (FPSO) units.

Responsibilities

  • You act in the integrity on-board FPSOs for Pressure systems (Piping, Pressure Vessel, hoses, and tubing).
  • You are responsible for the execution of the scopes for all equipment controlled, piping and pressure vessels in particular, including predictive maintenance, condition monitoring, quality assurance and quality control of subcontractors.
  • You ensure legal compliance, national regulatory requirements and keep certifications based on national or international standards and ordinances.
  • You ensure preparation, implementation, and monitoring of inspection plans of piping and pressure vessels controlled equipment, and organization of related activities with equipment inspector.
  • You define inspection techniques to guarantee the physical integrity of piping and pressure vessels. Implement new inspection technologies, and methodologies, special tests, engineering studies, etc.
  • You analyze the in‑service piping and pressure vessels structural integrity through inspections and nondestructive tests, assessment for fitness for service or risk‑based inspection to determine if the equipment is fit for continued service.
  • You embark in the operational units might be required for these activities to comply with local requirements.
  • You prepare, review, and approve inspection records, ensuring that are conclusive in accordance with the company procedures, standards, integrity management system, national legislation and ordinances, to attend certifications.
  • You approve, control, reassess and manage the inspection technical recommendations related to piping and pressure vessels inspections.
  • You support the frame agreement negotiations with subcontractors dealing with the activities in Piping and Pressure Vessel.
  • You collect KPIs to maintain the overall dashboard for Asset Integrity execution, inspection and monitoring.
  • You support the Asset Integrity Piping & Pressure Vessel specification for the new units.
  • You review annual inspection campaigns relative to the discipline.

Education

  • Bachelor Degree in Mechanical or Naval Engineering Disciplines, or equivalent.

Experience

  • Experience in the field inspection of piping and pressure vessels, following national and international standards and ordinances.
  • Extensive knowledge in design and Engineering as per process piping international standard (B31.3).
  • Extensive knowledge of pipe construction and piping repair techniques is a plus.
  • Extensive knowledge of Risk Based Inspection (RBI) methodology and standards is a plus.
  • Extensive knowledge in piping specification such as piping material class, material data sheet.
  • Design skill in Plant Desig Management System (PDMS) or Naviswork softwares.
  • Master’s degree or Post‑Graduation in a relevant subject to the activities (e.g. Metallurgical/Corrosion) or relevant certification in correlated areas is considered a competitive edge.
  • Be active with any mandatory registration and certifications required by national regulatory standards.

Functional Competencies

  • Piping - Piping Materials Monitoring performance and compliance
  • Regulatory Management Inspection, testing, commissioning and monitoring
  • Learning from events
  • Piping - Stress and Supports
  • Piping - Risk Based Inspection
  • Internal Audit Delivery Mechanical Static Equipment - Pressure Vessel Planning

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Hi there! We are South and our client is looking for a Customer Success Manager!

Note To Applicants

  • Eligibility: This position is open to candidates residing in Latin America.
  • Application Language: Please submit your CV in English. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered.
  • Professional Presentation: We encourage you to showcase your professional experience by including a Loom video in the application form. While this is optional, candidates who provide a video presentation will be given priority.
  • Note: If you're hired for this role, you may be asked to update your LinkedIn profile :)

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced and relationship-driven Customer Success Manager to own the heart of our business: the relationships between physicians and clinicians on the Single Aim platform. This is not a traditional support or ticket-closing role. You will be the face of Single Aim to our providers—acting as a matchmaker, problem solver, and trusted peer to the clinicians we serve.

This role is ideal for someone who speaks the language of healthcare, thrives in ambiguity, and enjoys building processes from scratch in a fast-growing startup environment. Whether you are a former clinician pivoting into tech or a HealthTech operator with strong operational instincts, this is a unique opportunity to shape the future of clinician relationships at Single Aim.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end onboarding for physicians, Nurse Practitioners (NPs), and Physician Assistants (PAs), from signup through successful matching.
  • Vet new providers, understand their practice needs, and guide them through the collaborative agreement and matching process.
  • Actively manage strategic matchmaking between physicians and NPs/PAs using high-touch communication (calls, texts, emails).
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for larger clients and key physician partners, ensuring trust, satisfaction, and retention.
  • Proactively identify and resolve complex relationship or operational issues before they escalate.
  • Operate comfortably in an evolving admin environment, manually fixing issues and using judgment to keep workflows moving.
  • Work closely with the Founder to translate customer feedback and pain points into product and process improvements.
  • Continuously refine and build scalable customer success processes and best practices.
  • Maintain accurate records of provider interactions, matches, and account status using internal tools, CRMs, and spreadsheets.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in Healthcare Customer Success, Provider Relations, or Clinical Operations.
  • OR a clinical background (NP, PA, RN) with a strong desire to move into a full-time operational or business role.
  • Deep familiarity with U.S. healthcare workflows, including credentialing, malpractice, supervision, and scope of practice.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to sound credible and peer-like to clinicians.
  • Highly proactive, outgoing, and comfortable picking up the phone to resolve issues quickly.
  • Ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, unstructured startup environment.
  • Tech-savvy and comfortable using CRMs, spreadsheets, and evolving admin dashboards.

Nice To Have

  • Licensed Nurse Practitioner (NP) or Physician Assistant (PA).
  • Experience working at an early-stage HealthTech startup (Seed to Series B).
  • Prior involvement in building or improving customer success or clinical operations processes.
  • Experience working in remote-first or high-growth startup environments.

Location & Logistics

Location: Fully Remote

Time Zone: U.S. time zones preferred

Type: Full-time (40 hours/week)

Salary Range: $3,500 – $4,500/month

Why Join Us?

  • Ownership: You will be the first full-time hire dedicated to Customer Success and will define how this function operates.
  • Impact: Your work directly enables NPs and PAs to start independent practices, expanding healthcare access nationwide.
  • Direct Access: Work closely with the Founder in a flat, high-trust environment.
  • Flexibility: Remote-first culture that values output over hours.

If this opportunity sounds good to you, send us your resume!

The Technology Stack

Qualifications

Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.

  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time‑Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.

  • Experience with Digital Twins , IoT, or Industrial Data.
  • Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents).

  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

Desired Profile

  • The Architect‑Implementer: You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query.
  • The Polyglot: You are likely a Backend or Full‑Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (NgRx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures.

Head de Mídia Brasil Estamos à procura de um Head de Mídia Brasil para co-liderar com a equipe de Marketing as combinações de marca e mercado atribuídas, com insumos estratégicos, implementação de campanhas, transformação digital e medição de desempenho das campanhas.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Implementar os valores agregados atribuídos às principais combinações de marca e mercado provenientes das negociações digitais com fornecedores-chave como Google e Facebook.
  • Conduzir e implementar a agenda de testes e aprendizados conforme os objetivos de mídia definidos no início de cada ano, alinhados à visão global e aos objetivos de negócios do Diretor de Marketing da Latam. Iterar e aprender com essas hipóteses e testes.

  • Co-liderar com equipes locais de marketing e atualizar mensalmente os fluxos de mídia local Haleon.

title: Full Stack Engineer ID47933
description:
AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US

If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior/Lead Full-Stack Engineer , you will help build a financial intelligence platform designed for AI consumption, turning complex data into actionable insights. This is a full-time role starting with a focused 6-month project, offering strong autonomy and fast execution in a product-driven environment. You will act as a hands-on utility player, working across frontend, backend, integrations, and light architecture while shaping a cohesive, customer-ready system. Successful delivery opens the opportunity to continue on other impactful projects.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Own the implementation and integration of existing product components, including AI usage dashboards and advisor insights.
  • Design and build backend functionality to support billing rules, chargeback logic, and ROI calculation for AI usage.
  • Integrate external billing data sources, starting with cloud billing systems.
  • Build and evolve APIs and data pipelines that translate raw billing data into usable financial insights.
  • Implement frontend functionality to surface metrics, dashboards, and data-heavy UI views clearly and pragmatically.
  • Make sound architectural decisions at a medium level of complexity, prioritizing maintainability and speed.
  • Collaborate closely with product stakeholders, operating with minimal process overhead.
  • Ensure smooth deployment and delivery workflows using Vercel.
  • Contribute to overall product cohesion by connecting disparate parts into a single, usable experience.
  • Work full-time on a 6-month project , with the opportunity to continue on other projects afterward.

MUST HAVES

  • 4+ years of experience and strong full-stack background with proven ability to move across frontend, backend, and integrations.
  • Solid experience with Python and Node.js in production environments.
  • Experience designing and working with PostgreSQL schemas and data models .
  • Direct experience integrating cloud billing systems or similar cost and usage APIs .
  • Experience building frontend applications deployed via Vercel (React or similar frameworks).
  • Strong experience consuming and integrating third-party APIs, especially billing or usage-based systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to work with incomplete requirements and turn them into working solutions.
  • Comfortable operating in early-stage product environments with limited structure.
  • Professional working proficiency in English.
  • Experience integrating frontend tests into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or similar).
  • Familiarity with observability and usage tracking concepts (OpenTelemetry or similar).
  • Experience building or consuming SDKs.

NICE TO HAVES

  • Experience with PHP.
  • Experience building financial, billing, or cost-allocation systems.
  • Familiarity with AI usage metrics, token-based billing, or ROI tracking models.
  • Experience working on dashboards, tables, filters, and data-dense UI patterns.
  • Prior startup or founder-led product experience.
  • Exposure to AI tooling workflows.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

  • Professional growth: Mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
  • Competitive compensation: USD-based pay with education, fitness, and team activity budgets.
  • Exciting projects: Modern solutions with Fortune 500 and top product companies.
  • Flextime: Flexible schedule with remote and office options.

Indústria contrata: Mecânico de RefrigeraçãoTipo de contrato:Contrato de trabalho temporárioModelo de trabalho:PresencialHorário de trabalho:Seg à Sexta de 07h às 17h, sábados alternados de 07h às 14h

Resumo:Realizar manutenções preventivas, corretivas e preditivas em sistemas de refrigeração, climatização e HVAC, incluindo testes, ajustes, lubrificação, monitoramento e correção de anomalias para garantir o adequado funcionamento dos equipamentos.

Responsabilidades

  • Cálculo de Carga Térmica: Avaliar o ambiente de instalação, dimensionar o local, identificar fontes de calor e especificar a capacidade do equipamento de ventilação ou refrigeração.
  • Especificação de Materiais e Acessórios: Definir tipo, modelo e tensão do equipamento, analisar projeto de instalação, avaliar local de instalação e requisitar materiais.
  • Instalação de Equipamentos: Selecionar ferramentas e equipamentos, medir o local de instalação, interpretar normas e procedimentos, instalar tubulações e drenos, interligar unidades evaporadoras e condensadoras e efetuar instalações elétricas.
  • Instalação de Ramais de Dutos: Marcar posições, confeccionar peças, montar e fixar dutos, acoplar juntas elásticas de vibração e registros de regulagem de ar.
  • Montagem de Tubulações de Refrigeração: Estabelecer percurso, dimensionar comprimentos, nivelar e fixar tubulações, efetuar pré-limpeza e pressurizar tubulações.
  • Aplicação de Vácuo: Despressurizar o sistema, conectar bomba de vácuo, instalar vacuômetro e monitorar pressão do vácuo.
  • Carga de Fluido Refrigerante: Conectar manômetros, cilindro de fluido refrigerante, expurgar o ar da mangueira e controlar a pressão do fluido refrigerante.
  • Testes nos Sistemas de Refrigeração: Verificar condições de alimentação elétrica, acionar equipamentos, controlar variáveis do sistema e monitorar funcionamento dos dispositivos de proteção e controle.
  • Checklist em Sistema de HVAC: Monitorar parâmetros de funcionamento do equipamento Chiller, unidades de tratamento de ar e realizar reparos quando necessário.
  • Execução de Tarefas Adicionais: Executar outras tarefas de mesma natureza e nível de complexidade associadas ao ambiente organizacional.
  • Monitoramento de Pressões, Temperatura e Umidade: Monitorar pressões, temperatura e umidade em salas classificadas e áreas de pesagem e amostragem.

Escolaridade

Ensino Médio Completo;Técnico em Refrigeração;

Competências Técnicas

  • Experiência prévia na área;
  • Desejável conhecimentos técnicos em Mecânica / Refrigeração / Elétrica.
  • Vivência em indústrias farmacêuticas, cosméticas ou alimentícias será considerada um diferencial.

Benefícios

  • Refeição no local;
  • Vale transporte;

description:
Overview

A missão desse cargo será auxiliar na prestação de cuidados aos pacientes em um ambiente hospitalar. Suas principais responsabilidades incluem a assistência direta aos pacientes, a realização de procedimentos técnicos e a colaboração com a equipe de saúde.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar as rotinas de enfermagem da Instituição (passagem de plantão, registro de intercorrências, notificações de eventos, etc.);
  • Manter o posto de Enfermagem organizado para as atividades laborativas;
  • Receber, conferir, administrar e devolver as medicações prescritas;
  • Executar a Sistematização da Assistência de Enfermagem – Prescrição de Enfermagem e Plano de Cuidados;
  • Realizar os registros seguros da sua prática profissional;
  • Realizar curativo simples e comunicar ao enfermeiro;
  • Preparar o paciente para exames e tratamentos internos e externos, se houver necessidade;
  • Observar, reconhecer e descrever sinais e sintomas, ao nível de sua qualificação, sempre comunicando ao Enfermeiro.
  • Executar tratamentos especificamente prescritos, ou de rotina, além de outras atividades de enfermagem;
  • Ministrar medicamentos por via oral, IM e uso tópico relatando quaisquer alterações e/ou intercorrências ao Enfermeiro responsável;
  • Administrar nebulização, enema e calor ou frio conforme prescrição;
  • Realizar o controle de pacientes e contactantes de doenças transmissíveis, sob a supervisão do Enfermeiro;
  • Colher material (Urina e Fezes) para exames laboratoriais por método convencional;
  • Prestar cuidados de enfermagem pré e pós-procedimentos;
  • Executar atividades de limpeza e desinfecção de materiais;
  • Verificar e registrar sinais vitais para monitorar o estado de saúde dos pacientes, como temperatura, pressão arterial, pulso, respiração e glicemia capilar;
  • Realizar registros precisos das informações dos pacientes, incluindo sinais vitais, medicamentos administrados, procedimentos realizados e observações relevantes sobre o estado do paciente;
  • Apoiar na realização da contenção mecânica;
  • Realizar rondas conforme plano de cuidados;
  • Possuir escuta ativa e sensível;
  • Realizar manejo e abordagem aos pacientes com instabilidade psíquica;
  • Prestar cuidados de higiene e conforto ao paciente;
  • Zelar pela sua segurança, controle de pertences de riscos (giletes, fio dental, removedor esmalte, esmaltes etc.);
  • Auxiliar e incentivar a realização das atividades de vida diárias, tais como higiene pessoal, alimentação, mobilidade e eliminação.
  • Auxiliar no posicionamento dos pacientes confortavelmente na cama e movê-los com segurança quando necessário;
  • Realizar mudança de decúbito em paciente acamado;
  • Atuar sob supervisão do enfermeiro em intercorrências clínicas e psíquicas;
  • Auxiliar e incentivar na organização dos pertences e quarto dos pacientes;
  • Zelar pela limpeza e ordem dos materiais, de equipamentos e de dependências de unidades de saúde;
  • Oferecer apoio emocional aos pacientes, ouvindo suas preocupações e fornecendo conforto sempre que necessário. Buscando sempre um profissional da Equipe multidisciplinar e Enfermeiro em situações de saúde emocionalmente desafiadora;
  • Integrar a equipe de Saúde reportando todos os dados para o enfermeiro responsável pelo setor;
  • Realizar apoio e interação com toda equipe multidisciplinar;
  • Realizar observação contínua aos pacientes e relatar quaisquer alterações aos enfermeiros responsáveis.
  • Participar de atividades em saúde, seguindo prescrição de enfermagem e médica;
  • Auxiliar o Enfermeiro na execução dos programas de Educação para a Saúde;
  • Executar trabalhos de rotina vinculados à alta de pacientes;
  • Participar de procedimentos pós morte;
  • Realizar a coleta venosa e de secreção oro e nasofaringe. Preparo e realização do teste Toxicológico, Covid 19, entre outros testes não invasivos.
  • Entre outras rotinas pertinentes ao cargo.

  • Ter curso de auxiliar de enfermagem;
  • COREN de AUXILIAR DE ENFERMAGEM ativo;
  • Possuir experiencia em saúde mental será um diferencial.

title: Analista De Desenvolvimento De Frontend Sênior
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:O Analista de frontend irá fazer parte do coração do time de operações de aplicações cloud native na execução e desenho da plataforma TOTVS Apps, através da evolução da infraestrutura de serviços, aplicativos, arquitetura e suas automatizações. A plataforma TOTVS Apps é utilizada por centenas de desenvolvedores e dezenas de produtos, com um potencial enorme de crescimento.O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:- Desenvolver soluções técnicas de alta complexidade, através do desenvolvimento de requisitos de softwares utilizando-se do conhecimento avançado de tecnologias front-end envolvidas no projeto;
- Conhecer a arquiteturafront-end do software e ser capaz de atuar nela através da análise de seus componentes, organização e funcionalidades;
- Criar testes de alta complexidade, sejam estes manuais ou automatizados, que cubram o comportamento desejado dos componentes técnicos desenvolvidos utilizando os requisitos e ferramentas de testes;
- Documentar as etapas de desenvolvimento realizando o registro nas ferramentas de versionamento e documentação;

- Garantir a qualidade do software verificando os processos, ferramentas e boas práticas disponíveis para o produto e tecnologia utilizados;
- Orientar o time de desenvolvimento apoiando suas dúvidas, disseminando seu conhecimento, desenhando e arquitetando soluções ou indicando documentação de apoio;
- Detalhar requisitos dealta complexidade através do contato com clientes e áreas envolvidas no projeto/atendimento;
- Contribuir em discussões sobre inovação e novas tendências de mercado através da constante atualização em tecnologias front-end com o intuito de disseminar o conhecimento entre a equipe;
- Sugerir melhorias nosprocessos da área do produto ou segmento que estiver atuando com base em seu conhecimento técnico com o objetivo de otimizar as suas entregas e dos envolvidos.O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:- Linguagem e frameworks de programação TypeScript – nível avançado;

- Conceitos de DevOps (Observabilidade, SRE, outros) – nível básico;
- Esteira (CI/CD) - intermediário;
- Arquitetura de Software (sistemas distribuídos, escalabilidade, Cloud Native, microsserviços, contêineres, outros) – nível avançado;
- Sistemas distribuídos(contêineres, kubernetes, swarm, outros) – nível básico;
- Testes unitários, técnicas de manutenibilidade e resolução de vulnerabilidades - nível avançado;
- Banco de Dados (SQL, NoSQL) – nível intermediário;
- Métodos ágeis de desenvolvimento de software –nível intermediário;

title: Senior Engineering Project Manager

title: Analista de Recursos Humanos III
description:
Descrição

O profissional atuará de forma estratégica, com forte orientação a dados, conduzindo e aprimorando os processos de Treinamento e Desenvolvimento. Será responsável por mapear competências, estruturar processos, analisar resultados e propor melhorias contínuas que fortaleçam a cultura, o clima e a retenção de talentos, assegurando direcionamento estratégico e decisões orientadas por dados.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Mapear competências e indicadores estratégicos do ciclo de performance. Implementar, revisar e aprimorar os processos da área de Treinamento e Desenvolvimento. Utilizar dados e métricas para embasar ações e recomendações. Propor melhorias contínuas que fortaleçam cultura, clima e retenção. Contribuir para padronização, evolução e escalabilidade dos processos já existentes. Estruturar ações de trilha de carreira, sucessão e reconhecimento. Estimular a retenção de talentos por meio de análise de indicadores e implementação de ações direcionadas. Acompanhar e otimizar projetos existentes, proporcionando padronização, eficiência e evolução contínua.

Requisitos e qualificações

Ensino superior completo em Administração, Gestão de Recursos Humanos, Psicologia, Engenharia de Produção ou áreas correlatas. Experiência com melhoria e redesenho de processos de ciclo de performance, clima e cultura organizacional. Forte orientação a dados, métricas e análise para tomada de decisão. Atuação estratégica em RH corporativo. Inglês Intermediário/Avançado.

title: Assistente Fiscal Sênior
description:
Descrição

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional para atuar no controle, apuração e conciliações de retenções tributárias (federais, previdenciárias e municipais), garantindo conformidade fiscal, precisão dos cálculos e suporte às áreas internas. A pessoa será responsável por analisar notas fiscais de serviços tomados, validar incidências, apurar impostos retidos e alimentar corretamente as obrigações acessórias, especialmente EFD-Reinf e DCTFWeb.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Analisar notas fiscais de serviços tomados e identificar incidência de IRRF, PIS, COFINS, CSLL, INSS e ISS. Calcular, validar e consolidar retenções federais e previdenciárias. Emitir e conferir guias (DARF, GPS, DCTFWeb) e controlar retenções a compensar/recuperar. Organizar e enviar corretamente os eventos da EFD-Reinf (R-2010, R-2020, R-2060 e futuramente R-2070). Realizar conciliações entre notas fiscais, valores retidos, recolhimentos e débitos da DCTFWeb. Elaborar relatórios mensais por fornecedor e tipo de tributo. Manter planilhas/sistemas atualizados e prestar suporte ao Contas a Pagar em dúvidas sobre retenções. Garantir conformidade fiscal e correta classificação tributária.

Requisitos e qualificações

Ensino Superior Completo. Conhecimento sólido em retenções federais (IRRF/PIS/COFINS/CSLL). Domínio das regras de retenções previdenciárias (11% INSS, CPRB). Conhecimento das regras de ISS quando aplicável. Vivência com análise de notas fiscais de serviços. Capacidade de leitura e aplicação de legislação tributária. Excel intermediário. Perfil colaborativo, organizado, com boa capacidade de comunicação e gestão de demandas.

title: ANALISTA FINANCEIRO
description:
Descrição

A Vivere Entretenimento está em busca de Analista Fiscal Contábil para integrar nossa equipe na Barra da Tijuca – RJ.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Execução e apoio nas rotinas fiscais do escritório;
Apuração de tributos de acordo com os diferentes regimes tributários;
Elaboração, conferência e envio de obrigações acessórias;
Apuração de impostos indiretos, como INSS, IRPJ, CSLL, ICMS, ISS, PIS e COFINS;
Emissão e controle de certidões negativas;
Organização, conferência e controle de documentos fiscais;
Apoio na emissão de Notas Fiscais.

Requisitos e qualificações

Ensino superior completo em Ciências Contábeis;
Experiência anterior em escritório contábil;
Conhecimento prático em rotinas fiscais e obrigações acessórias.

title: Coordenador Financeiro Jr
description:
Descrição

Se você está em busca de um novo desafio que potencialize suas habilidades e contribua para o crescimento de uma empresa em expansão, temos uma oportunidade empolgante para você. Estamos à procura de profissionais motivados, que desejam fazer a diferença em um ambiente colaborativo e dinâmico. Valorizamos a capacidade de pensar estrategicamente, a facilidade em se adaptar a novas situações e a determinação em alcançar resultados. Aqui, você terá a chance de trabalhar em projetos inovadores, cercado por uma equipe comprometida e apaixonada pelo que faz. Junte-se a nós nessa jornada e ajude a moldar o futuro financeiro da nossa organização. Se você está pronto para dar o próximo passo na sua carreira, queremos conhecer sua história e suas ideias. Venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Gerir os processos e equipes das áreas de Contabilidade, Custos e Financeira, assegurando conformidade legal, normatização e eficiência operacional.
Desenvolver e implementar estratégias financeiras para o alcance das metas de curto e longo prazo.
Elaborar e acompanhar o orçamento anual, garantindo que os gastos estejam alinhados às metas da associação.
Supervisionar registros contábeis, fechamentos e análises financeiras, garantindo precisão e aderência às normas vigentes.
Controlar o fluxo de caixa, prever entradas e saídas e garantir liquidez adequada.
Analisar desempenho financeiro, propor melhorias e otimizar custos.
Preparar relatórios financeiros para a diretoria, com análises e recomendações.
Estabelecer e manter relacionamento com bancos e instituições financeiras, negociando condições favoráveis.
Avaliar e mitigar riscos financeiros, definindo estratégias preventivas.
Liderar e desenvolver equipe, promovendo motivação, disciplina e alinhamento às diretrizes organizacionais.
Manter-se atualizado sobre legislação, tendências e boas práticas do setor.

Requisitos e qualificações

Formação superior completa em Ciências Contábeis.
Experiência consolidada em gestão financeira e contábil, preferencialmente em associações, cooperativas ou empresas de serviços.
Sólido conhecimento em contabilidade, análise financeira, fluxo de caixa, orçamento e controle de custos.
Experiência com liderança e desenvolvimento de equipes.
Domínio de Excel e ferramentas de gestão financeira.

title: Gerente de HSE
description:
Descrição

Buscamos um(a) Gerente de HSE para liderar estrategicamente as atividades de Saúde, Segurança, Meio Ambiente e Qualidade, assegurando a conformidade legal, normativa e contratual das operações. Este(a) profissional será responsável por gerenciar o Sistema de Gestão da empresa e promover a cultura de segurança.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Gerenciar, projetar e implementar programas, atividades e rotinas de HSE; Gerenciar o Sistema de Gestão da empresa, garantindo sua atualização e revisão conforme práticas e procedimentos estabelecidos; Garantir o atendimento aos requisitos legais e outros requisitos aplicáveis, monitorando conformidades e reportando à alta gestão; Acompanhar e participar das investigações de incidentes, ações corretivas e preventivas do QHSE e apoiar outros departamentos quando necessário; Assegurar treinamentos contínuos aos colaboradores para reforço dos conhecimentos de HSE; Estabelecer inspeções periódicas em locais de trabalho, equipamentos e embarcações; Definir métodos de avaliação de riscos de saúde ocupacional e higiene industrial; Garantir que EPIs sejam adquiridos conforme a legislação vigente e que os colaboradores sejam devidamente treinados para seu uso; Avaliar documentos controlados para atendimento às leis, regulamentos, normas e requisitos de clientes; Liderar e apoiar auditorias internas e externas; Gerenciar e conduzir as reuniões do Comitê de Segurança; Consolidar e monitorar dados de HSE provenientes das áreas, reportando-os à alta gestão; Representar a empresa junto a clientes, órgãos governamentais e agências reguladoras; Atuar em colaboração com a GIS nos EUA para troca de boas práticas e implementação no Brasil; Desenvolver, manter e assegurar a conformidade da Matriz de Treinamentos Normativos para colaboradores próprios e terceiros.

Requisitos e qualificações

Ensino Superior completo; Experiência anterior na área de HSE ou em gestão de equipes; Inglês avançado; Conhecimento avançado em Microsoft Office (Word, Excel e PowerPoint); Conhecimento das legislações e regulamentos brasileiros e internacionais de HSE; Conhecimento do Guia de Gestão Marinho ABS (Saúde, Segurança, Qualidade e Meio Ambiente); Conhecimento dos padrões ISO 9001:2015, Código ISM, ISO 14001:2015 e ISO 45001:2018.

title: Supervisor de Compras Senior
description:
Descrição

Se você busca uma oportunidade desafiadora em um ambiente dinâmico e estimulante, temos o prazer de convidá-lo(a) a explorar uma posição que pode transformar sua trajetória profissional. Aqui, valorizamos o talento e a dedicação, oferecendo um espaço para que suas habilidades sejam reconhecidas e ampliadas. Job Description

Job Overview:

Provide emergency and routine medical care to workers on board.

We are currently exploring potential candidates for an upcoming role at McDermott. While this position is not yet open for active recruitment, we want to connect with talented individuals who may be interested in future projects with us. If you are passionate about building energy’s future, and want to be considered when this role becomes available, we encourage you to submit your details.

Preferred Qualifications and Education:

  • Desirable offshore experience

A Iqony Solutions do Brasil é uma subsidiária da Iqony Solutions GmbH, fornecedor conhecido internacionalmente pelos serviços especializados no setor energético, atuando em mais de 80 países em todo o mundo. Desde 2002, a Iqony Solutions do Brasil, com sede no Rio de Janeiro, oferece seus serviços nas áreas de Engenharia, Consultoria e Operação & Manutenção para clientes na América do Sul em usinas de geração de energia. O grupo é proprietário de aproximadamente 7.6 GW de capacidade instalada, incluindo plantas Eólicas, Térmicas, Solar, entre outras. Ao lado do investidor, oferecemos as melhores soluções para Engenharia e Operação & Manutenção. Atualmente, a Iqony Solutions GmbH opera mais de 6 GW de terceiros e 7.6 GW de plantas próprias. A Iqony Solutions do Brasil também oferece serviços no setor de energias renováveis com contratos no Brasil que somam mais de 5 GW. A empresa também possui um Centro de Operação e Monitoramento Remoto, situado no Rio de Janeiro.

A IQONY Solutions do Brasil Ltda, assume o compromisso de atuação baseando-se na valorização e respeito aos direitos humanos, rejeitando todas as formas de discriminação, e está comprometida em promover e valorizar a diversidade, inclusão e equidade de tratamento em todos os níveis e processos da organização, zelando por um ambiente saudável e equilibrado de trabalho.

  • Seja concluída dentro do orçamento e do prazo.
  • Minimize o transtorno causado pela obra.

As principais funções do síndico no contexto de obras são:

  • Garantir a Segurança e a Conformidade Legal
    Exigir o cumprimento da NBR 16.280 e do regimento interno do condomínio em todas as reformas, seja nas áreas comuns ou nas unidades privativas.
    Zelar pela conservação e segurança da edificação (Art. 1.348, V, do Código Civil), responsabilizando‑se por qualquer dano causado por negligência na fiscalização.
  • Autorizações e Documentação
    Analisar e aprovar o Plano de Reforma detalhado antes de qualquer obra ser iniciada.
    Exigir a Anotação de Responsabilidade Técnica (ART) ou o Registro de Responsabilidade Técnica (RRT), assinados por engenheiro ou arquiteto habilitado, garantindo que um profissional seja o responsável técnico pela obra.
    Manter a documentação da obra arquivada.
Requisitos
  • I. Requisitos Técnicos e Legais
    • Conhecimento da NBR 16.280: É obrigatório que o síndico conheça a fundo a norma que trata da Gestão de Reformas em Edificações.
    • Noções Básicas de Construção Civil: capacidade de ler e interpretar plantas simples, entender orçamentos, cronogramas e etapas.
    • Domínio do Código Civil (Obras): conhecer os quóruns de aprovação de obras (Artigos 1.341 a 1.343).
    • Habilidade em Análise de Documentos: analisar e arquivar corretamente ARTs, RRTs, laudos de inspeção, contratos e garantias.
    • Gestão de Contratos: conhecer aspectos essenciais de contratos de empreitada/serviço.

title: Software Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Linux Kernel
description:
Software Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Linux Kernel

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Linux Kernel role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open‑source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT.

Our customers include the world’s leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring Software Engineering Managers to lead technical teams in the various aspects of the delivery and ongoing support and maintenance of all Linux kernels provided by the Ubuntu Linux distribution. As the Linux kernel itself is now quite broad, so are the technical domains and challenges involved, ranging from integrating support for bleeding‑edge hardware into the latest Ubuntu kernels, to expanding the range of execution environments available to Ubuntu, to the complexities inherent in applying the latest fixes and updates to all of the >100 Ubuntu Linux kernels under active support during our Stable Release Update cycles.

This role would suit either an experienced manager of high‑performing software development teams, or a very proficient technical lead who is excited to take on a management responsibility. You will need to be passionate about Linux and aspire to be an integral part in its distribution to millions of users worldwide.

The role entails

  • Leading a distributed team of software engineers in your geographic region in distinct aspects of delivery of all Linux kernels for the Ubuntu Linux distribution.
  • Taking ownership of particular aspects of Ubuntu Linux which can include but not be limited to:
    • Working with silicon or cloud partners to implement Linux kernels optimised for their execution environments.
    • Ensuring Ubuntu Linux is able to run on a wide range of diverse hardware platforms.
    • Definition and execution of the stringent quality control standards expected by the Ubuntu user community.
    • Mitigation of the latest security threats and exploits to the Linux kernel.
    • Strong process automation as it pertains to the build, test, and delivery of the Linux kernel.
  • Engagement with other teams at Canonical, the open source community and commercial partners.

What we are looking for in you

  • Significant programming experience in C, with Python, Golang, or other like languages is also highly regarded.
  • Substantial experience with operating system kernel internals and concepts, Linux would be highly regarded but not essential.
  • Demonstrated experience managing or leading a team of software engineers.
  • Ability to coordinate between multiple distinct teams of differing technical focus to achieve common goals.
  • Familiarity with version control practices, ideally with git.
  • Prior experience developing with software packaging formats, with direct Ubuntu/Debian/Snap experience being highly regarded.
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills.
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long.

Nice-to-have skills

  • Demonstrated experience with kernel patching and debugging.
  • Strong grasp of device drivers, BSPs, and other low‑level system engineering.
  • Solid background in driving CI/CD and process automation initiatives.
  • Prior public involvement with an open source project.

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person.
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.
  • Annual compensation review.
  • Recognition rewards.
  • Annual holiday leave.
  • Maternity and paternity leave.
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform.
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events.

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

  • Maximize Net Present Value (NPV) and hydrocarbon recovery.

  • Prepare critical reservoir engineering inputs for drilling and workover proposals and programs, recommending innovative completion techniques for complex well configurations, including: horizontal and multilateral wells.
  • Lead and participate in reservoir engineering studies focused on optimizing ultimate recovery through reservoir stimulation modeling of various Improved Oil Recovery (IOR) processes.

  • Technical knowledge and expertise are required in formation evaluation, geological modeling, simulation, reservoir appraisal and field development planning, completion, production/injection procedures-strategy‑technologies, water flooding, reservoir surveillance, SCAL, PVT, geochemical analysis, and fluid's compatibility.

With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

description:
Por que trabalhar conosco?

Porque somos a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos a nossos colaboradores, bem como os serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de dezenas de cidades, levando saúde, dignidade e bem-estar.

A Concessionária

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea, é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Descrição da vaga

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizará o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipal, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa. Em 2020 passou por uma revisão e seu objetivo foi reconfigurado: espelhar a população negra em todos os níveis hierárquicos. Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

Com um amplo portfólio de medicamentos, suplementos e cosméticos, atua em dois segmentos: medicamentos de prescrição médica (RX) em diversas especialidades terapêuticas, e consumo (OTC) produtos para o autocuidado, isentos de prescrição médica, destinados diretamente ao consumidor final.

A FQM, com mais de 1.500 colaboradores, vem escrevendo sua história por meio de constante aprimoramento do seu portfólio de produtos e processos e da busca incessante pela inovação e excelência para atender às necessidades do mercado farmacêutico no país, promovendo Saúde, Autoestima, Bem-estar e Qualidade de Vida à toda população.

Tenha facilidade de relacionamento com diferentes perfis;

Possua visão orientada a dados;

Tenha habilidade de comunicação oral e escrita;

Tenha bom planejamento do tempo;

Tenha brilho nos olhos e seja protagonista da sua carreira... seu lugar é aqui!

  • Realizar estudos de capacidade da fábrica, simulando cenários para propor táticas alinhadas com a estratégia da diretoria. Realizando análise do MFV, detecção de gargalos e criação de projetos de melhoria de ganho de capacidade e eliminação de desperdícios;
  • Calcular o ritmo das famílias produtivas da fábrica, assim como realizar o acompanhamento diário através do Heijunka;
  • Realizar o monitoramento do Sistema de Eficiência Geral do Equipamento (OEE), assim como realizar reuniões no gemba com equipes multidisciplinares, avaliando a eficiência do processo e estimulando melhorias contínuas;

description:
Join to apply for the Chief Compliance Officer role at Inside Higher Ed

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. URL:

Basic Function

This position serves as the Chief Compliance Officer, overseeing the university’s compliance program, that promotes honesty, integrity and adherence to internal policies and external regulatory requirements. The Chief Compliance Officer requires extensive experience in Compliance to effectively promote a culture of integrity, advise leadership and navigate complex University operations.

The institutional Compliance Program reinforces the University’s commitment to meeting the highest standards of ethics, integrity, and responsibility, providing independent and objective oversight of the University's compliance program to ensure that the University is compliant with all federal, state, and local laws and regulations as well as University policies.

The Chief Compliance Officer will report directly to Howard University’s Office of President and to the Board of Trustees.

Supervisory Accountability

The Chief Compliance Officer will have direct supervisory oversight of the Compliance divisions across the enterprise to include Howard University, Howard University Health Sciences and Howard University Hospital.

Principal Accountabilities
  • Leads the enterprise‑wide Compliance program in accordance with the 7 Elements of an Effective Compliance Program as promulgated by the Federal Sentencing Guidelines by promoting and managing the University’s Code of Ethical Conduct, maintaining and managing the Howard University Compliance hotline and other reporting channels facilitating and overseeing campus compliance committees, advising on conflict of interest issues and leading compliance training efforts across the enterprise.
  • Serves as liaison to the Audit and Legal Committee of Howard University’s Board of Trustees, and reporting to the committee during scheduled or ad hoc meetings to keep the Board apprised of present and emerging audit and compliance issues.
  • Meets external parties on compliance topics as a representative of the University; participates in the President’s staff meetings as requested and, represents the compliance function in various standing and ad hoc University committees and departments, and meets frequently with various groups of key administrators and leaders across the enterprise to report and advise.
  • Responsible for all administrative and leadership functions for the Office of Audit and Compliance, including hiring, supervision, and other personnel decisions; managing the departmental budget and resources effectively and efficiently; maintaining a professional audit, compliance, and Title IX staff with sufficient knowledge, skills, experience, and professional certifications to meet the requirements of internal and external directives; and overseeing departmental strategic planning.
Core Competencies
  • A minimum of 10 years of professional audit experience in a leadership position(s) preferably in higher education and research.
  • Requires in‑depth knowledge of regulatory frameworks relevant to academic and research institutions is necessary and a high degree of competency in investigative processes and an understanding and ability for collaborative engagement within the cross‑functional University operations.
  • Active participation in professional organizations in a leadership role, speaking, writing articles, or active committee participation.
  • Experience in building, training, and developing strong audit teams of five or more professional staff.
  • Experience in operational/program analysis, quality improvement, and efficiency and effectiveness reviews is a plus. Experience with a large public university system and an understanding of a university environment and its unique characteristics.
  • Knowledge of the operation of a large university system, a four‑year university campus including academic areas, athletics, auxiliary services, and student services, and/or an academic health care center. The ability to prepare comprehensive reports and presentations, utilizing excellent verbal and written communication skills, public speaking, and training skills as well as excellent analytical and problem‑solving skills.
  • In‑depth knowledge of current compliance practices, risk assessment, and investigative processes.
  • Skill in preparing or monitoring the preparation of comprehensive reports, interpreting and applying policies and regulations, and conducting interviews. The ability to present training and information on fraud prevention, effective controls, and best practices to faculty, staff, and management.
  • Supervisory skills including the ability to motivate professional staff at different locations across the state, including educating and promoting a culture of learning while serving as a mentor and advocate.
  • Ability to organize work and prioritize objectives; to evaluate evidence; to exercise independent judgment; to plan, implement, evaluate and report activities.
  • Skill in establishing and maintaining working relationships and managing and resolving conflicts with diverse constituencies across UT System.
  • Willingness to travel.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and objectivity. Soundness of judgment is necessary to lead the institutional compliance function. Ability to effectively interact with and communicate information to senior management and the Audit and Compliance Committee, including the ability to be transparent, open, and with a demonstrated commitment to the highest ethical and professional standards.
  • Ability to be nimble, flexible, and handle ambiguity well.
  • Ability to communicate and demonstrate interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence through personal credibility, integrity, and professionalism.
  • A commitment to affirmative action, equal employment opportunity, diversity, and inclusion.
Minimum Requirements
  • A Bachelor’s degree.
  • Compliance Certification is required (Certified Compliance & Ethics Professional (CCEP)).

title: Bruna Carvalho appointed to Managing Director, Brazil
description:
Bruna Carvalho appointed to Managing Director, Brazil

Share

We are delighted to announce that Bruna Carvalho has been appointed to Managing Director, Brazil, effective immediately.

Bruna joined Clarksons in September 2024 and is now firmly establishing Clarksons’ Deep-Sea Tanker desk in Rio de Janeiro. South America is becoming an increasingly significant market. Providing an on-the-ground presence in the region ensures Clarksons is well placed to support clients as the market and opportunity grows. Bruna’s 18-year career at Petrobras has afforded her a wealth of experience and leadership expertise.

“Bruna has demonstrated impact since day one – she fits in well to the Clarksons culture, has contributed tremendously to the relaunch of Clarksons in Rio and has established herself as a strong leader. We are confident that her vision and drive will be instrumental in shaping the next exciting phase of our growth and success in the region, and that she will contribute hugely to the global management team at Clarksons.”

Andi CaseCEO

“My first 9 months at Clarksons have been fantastic. First and foremost, my focus is establishing the tankers presence - nurturing new and existing client relationships and demonstrating the insight and expertise that is available when partnering with Clarksons. I’ve had the opportunity to represent the business at global events, to connect and contribute towards internal networks within Clarksons, and together with the team have shaped our brand-new office space - I feel empowered and very proud to be part of this dynamic and forward-thinking business.”

The Brazil office currently has 20 employees across four service lines – Deep Sea Tankers, Specialised Products, Dry Cargo and Offshore & Renewables. A special mention must go to Jens Behrendt who has laid very strong foundations in the running of the office to date and will continue to head up the region’s Offshore and Renewables desk. Last month, the team hosted a joint celebration with more than 500 clients at the top of Sugar Loaf Mountain, to mark the new office opening in the centre of Rio, providing the space to scale and more than double headcount over the next couple of years.

  • Recruit, mentor, and develop clinical operations managers and support staff.

Financial & Strategic Management
  • Partner with finance teams to develop and manage budgets for clinical operations.
  • Monitor revenue cycle performance and implement strategies to optimize reimbursement.
  • Support strategic planning initiatives, including expansion of service lines and adoption of innovative care models.
Quality & Compliance
  • Ensure adherence to accreditation standards, regulatory requirements, and institutional policies.
  • Collaborate with quality improvement teams to monitor patient safety indicators and implement corrective actions.
  • Lead operational readiness for audits and inspections.
Core Competencies
  • Strategic thinking and problem‑solving

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills
  • Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast‑paced environment
Minimum Qualifications

  • Infraestrutura de TI: administração de servidores (Windows/Linux), redes, storage, gestão de ambientes críticos.

This global leadership role in cyber security is to manage the Security Operations (SecOps) team responsible for design, implementation and evolution of Canonical security practices, techniques, tools, systems and policies. The team is the primary owner of strategy and practices that determine how Canonical secures its data, internal infrastructure and build processes. They are responsible for assuring the security and integrity of our own infrastructure and product deployments. They design and implement technical security controls that ensure security threats are automatically identified, contained and remediated. The team will also contribute ideas and requirements for Canonical product security, improving the resilience and robustness of all Ubuntu customers and users subject to cyber attack.

As a leader on cyber security in the company, the SecOps team manager will collaborate with our Organisational Learning and Development team to develop playbooks and facilitate SecOps training across Canonical. They will operate in a wider security organisation, run a high performing security team and improve Canonical's security posture. They will lead initiatives to integrate the team's insights into Canonical's broader software development process.

While this is a management position, we expect managers to be expert practitioners, able to lead by example, contribute at the highest level, and assess work based on their own professional experience and skill. Candidates should have deep, hands-on expertise with a range of open source and proprietary security tooling and practices, which they can integrate into a holistic next generation security solution across the breadth of Canonical's interests.

The SecOps team's mission is not only to secure Canonical, but also to contribute to the security of the wider open source ecosystem. They might share knowledge through public presentations and industry events, and share threat intelligence with the wider community or represent Canonical in sector-specific governance bodies.

This role reports to the CISO.

What you will do in this role:

  • Hire and mentor a team of outstanding technical security professionals
  • Define Canonical's SecOps security standards and playbooks
  • Own and drive the architecture and design of the SOC
  • Analyse and improve Canonical's security architecture
  • Evaluate, select and implement new security tools and practices
  • Identify, contain and guide the remediation of security threats and cyber attacks
  • Grow the presence and thought leadership of Canonical SecOps practice
  • Contribute to open source threat intelligence initiatives
  • Drive threat modelling, table top exercises and other SecOps practices across Engineering, IS and Canonical
  • Develop Canonical SecOps learning and development materials
  • Publish blog posts, whitepapers and conference presentations
  • Identify, implement and track SecOps KPIs
  • Plan and deliver SecOps work in the framework of Canonical's agile engineering practice
  • Work with Security leadership to present information and influence change

What we are looking for

  • Proven track record of mitigating with advanced threat actors and nation state threats
  • Expert technical understanding of SOCs from the ground up
  • In depth knowledge of SOC architecture and design including strategies for logging, firewalls, network segmentation, honeypots etc
  • Someone who understands how the SOC works not just how to use it
  • Expert in Linux security
  • Ability to define, implement, automate and measure effective incident response playbooks
  • Knowledge of security architecture and market-leading security tools
  • Experience contributing to, and consuming, threat intelligence feeds
  • Experience in security risk management frameworks such as NIST CSF
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Deep personal motivation to be at the forefront of technology security
  • Leadership and management ability
  • Excellent business English writing and presentation skills
  • Confidence to report security performance metrics with accountability for accuracy and completeness

Optional things we value

  • Experience in offensive or defensive security teams with hands-on ability
  • Experience with open source security tools
  • Experience with security standards such as ISO 27001
  • Experience with security posture management of corporate endpoitns

Atenta às novas tendências, a empresa passou a comprar blocos de espuma para a confecção de colchões, que harmoniosamente se casavam com as camas. Em 1975, a Ortobom inaugurou no Rio de Janeiro a primeira fábrica especializada na fabricação de colchões. O objetivo era a produção e comercialização de colchões que proporcionassem o máximo de bem-estar e conforto aos clientes. O sonho virou realidade. Hoje a Ortobom possui 12 fábricas e 400.000 m2 de área construída. São mais de 2.000 lojas no Brasil, com filiais também na Bolívia, Uruguai e Paraguai. O setor fabril, se somado, tem uma área superior a de grandes montadoras de automóveis. A Ortobom é a maior produtora de colchões da América Latina e a 2ª maior produtora de espuma do mundo. title: Danielle Bibas é nomeada CEO da Pierre Fabre
description:
Com longo histórico na Avon e passagem de um ano pelo Grupo Petrópolis executiva substitui Ana Paula Magri. Danielle Bibas acaba de assumir o cargo de chief executive officer (CEO) da filial brasileira da companhia francesa Pierre Fabre, sediada no Rio de Janeiro.

Ela substitui Ana Paula Magri, que havia sido a primeira pessoa brasileira a ocupar o comando da empresa no País.

Com isso, Danielle estará à frente do negócio que, no Brasil, comercializa as marcas Eau Thermal Avène (marca francesa especializada em dermocosméticos e uma das líderes em venda na Europa), Ducray (também francesa e focada em alta ciência e medicalização) e Darrow Laboratório (marca brasileira de dermocosméticos para pele oleosa e que, segundo a empresa faz sucesso entre a GenZ e começou a ser exportada para outros países da América Latina recentemente).

Danielle trabalhou como CMO do Grupo Petrópolis de setembro de 2022 a setembro de 2023, mas antes disso teve um longo histórico na Avon.

Na companhia de beleza, onde trabalhou por 12 anos, ocupou os cargos de CMO no Brasil e vice-presidente de marketing global. Imediatamente antes da Avon, também teve um histórico de 16 anos na P&G, onde também lidou com a categoria de saúde e beleza, tendo seu último cargo por lá sido o de presidente de Health and Beauty Care, no Canadá.

Metas estabelecidas

Há dois anos, a filial brasileira da Pierre Fabre – cujo faturamento global gira em torno de € 2,8 bilhões – ocupava a 10ª posição no mapa da companhia. E a então CEO, Ana Paula, afirmava que o objetivo era que o Brasil subisse cinco posições nesse ranking, dobrando o tamanho dos negócios até 2026.

Na cidade de Areal, no Rio de Janeiro, está instalada a única fábrica da Pierre Fabre fora da França. E desde 2018 o País também abriga o Brazilian Innovation Center (BIC), focado no desenvolvimento de produtos para a população local.

We go beyond what was once thought possible, creating new and innovative solutions to the world’s most complex problems. You will be instrumental in advancing BCG’s Consulting and BCG X teams by providing critical software development insights and speeding up project execution.

As a Software Engineer, your role involves close collaboration with consulting teams to address complex and diverse technological challenges. You will apply your expertise in software development methodologies to add value to BCG’s Consulting & BCG X teams and Practice Areas.

Each project offers a unique opportunity to showcase your skills and make a significant impact within BCG and our esteemed clientele.

What You’ll Bring

We are seeking technologically adept engineers who bring strong experience and diverse skills to our dynamic team. This role is an outstanding opportunity for someone who is passionate about software development and embraces opportunities to learn and make an impact in a fast‑paced, innovative environment. If you’re driven by technology and ready for impactful challenges, our BCG X Delivery team could be a great match!

Technical Skills – Knowledge and Experience With
  • Coding Skills: Strong coding skills and proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, Kotlin, Node.js, Go, Ruby, Rust, C#, etc. Experience with multiple languages preferred.

  • Knowledge of infrastructure as code practices using Terraform, Chef, Puppet, or Ansible.
Job Requirements
  • Bachelor’s / Master’s in Computer Science or a related field
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English
  • Proven background in end‑to‑end application development, preferably in a commercial or consulting environment.
  • Active contributions to open‑source projects or technical communities are highly valued.
Core Attributes
  • Software Development: Demonstrated experience in developing, testing, and deploying robust software. Examples of past projects or contributions are advantageous.

  • Dynamic Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a fast‑paced, client‑facing environment. Experience in client interactions for product development is a plus.

Please apply for the positions equivalent to your previous work experiences. The seniority will be evaluated according to your experience and career structure at BCG X during the process.

A Concessionária

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Job Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”), which for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Commercial & Marketing

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Position Overview

The Head of Brand & Marketing at FWWC27 LTDA, which is FIFA’s Brazilian subsidiary responsible for the delivery of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Brazil (TM), will be tasked to guide and implement brand and marketing plans, campaigns and activations in line with the marketing & communication strategy. This role is critical to the success of the first ever FIFA Women’s World Cup to be held in South America with a vision to unite the world through an unprecedented experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Key Responsibilities
  • Act as an extension to, and be part of the global MBBI (Marketing, Brand, Business Intelligence) team based in Zurich with dual reporting lines, for being a key representative to all Brand, Marketing and Promotion Tournament matters.
  • Responsible for all promotional aspects including any communications designed and required to support the commercial and marketing objectives of the tournament.
  • Be the main liaison for Host Country and Host City representatives, tournament executive leadership representing the MBBI team.
  • Lead the local, regional and national delivery of various marketing campaigns and initiatives related to, and beyond identified tournament milestones.
  • Lead a team of brand & marketing professionals on the ground, and ensure seamless cooperation, collaboration and integration with all relevant functional areas at FWWC27 LTDA and FIFA’s head office in Zurich, as well as any other functional areas such as legal, finance, etc.
  • Identify and communicate opportunities to create dedicated local, regional or national promotional activities that support the objectives of the tournament, the marketing strategy, or any relevant stakeholders such as commercial partners, media partners, host cities, and others.
  • Identify and drive commercial value through the marketing of the tournament’s brand assets and intellectual property, including but not limited to mascots, licensing & retail, the FIFA Fan Festival, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Trophy Tour, official music tracks/album/sonic identities, and other.
  • Contribute to, and drive implementation of ticketing & hospitality go-to-market strategy and activations plans.
  • Establish and maintain strong and impactful relationships with relevant partners, celebrities, influencers, key event organizers, agencies, etc.
  • Manage and maintain budget and liaise with the relevant colleagues in Zurich in all matters budget and spend.
  • Oversee the correct implementation and utilization of all in-market tournament brand asset implementations and applications including, but not limited to, event and stadium dressing, experiential marketing applications, retail branding, and any other use of the brand assets by FIFA’s internal and external stakeholders.
  • Manage procurement and legal processes (in compliance with FWWC27 LTDA policies and guidelines) as it relates to the tendering and contracting of local, regional or national suppliers, service providers, agencies, and other.
  • Manage and deliver all necessary reporting measures related to the tournament.
  • Drive and manage effective communications between the relevant functional areas and, in particular with the MBBI team in Zurich.
Your Profile
  • Bachelor’s degree or similar higher education in marketing, or a marketing related discipline.
  • Minimum 10 years’ experience in a relevant leadership position.
  • Proven experience delivering major brand & marketing plans.
  • Experience in the sports and/or entertainment industry is a major plus.
  • Experience working in a global or international environment.
  • Proven track record in managing a team in a matrix or similar structure.
  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills and the ability to manage up, down and sideways.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills.
  • Profound knowledge of Brazilian and South American markets and culture.
  • Ability to work to deadlines and stress resilient.
  • Financial and budget management.

  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: MSF Access Executive Director
description:
Location: Strong preference to be based in one of the five MSF Access Regional Hubs (Rio de Janeiro, Dakar, Brussels, Nairobi, and Kuala Lumpur). Placement in associated strategic locations may be considered.

Duration: MSF office contract, minimum 3 years commitment, extendable by 3 years, according to MSF practice and subject to national labour laws

Deadline to Apply:

Compensation and benefits: MSF practice is to offer the C&B package current in the MSF entity establishing the contract.

Reporting to: The MSF Access Executive Board

Start date: Beginning of Q2 2026 preferred with some flexibility depending on individual circumstances

MSF INTERNATIONAL

Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent, medical humanitarian organisation that delivers emergency aid to people affected by armed conflict, epidemics, healthcare exclusion and natural disasters. MSF offers assistance to people based only on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation. MSF International is the legal entity that binds MSF’s 24 sections, 28 associations and other offices together. Based in Geneva, MSF International provides coordination, information and support to the MSF movement, and implements international projects and initiatives as requested. MSF is committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, nationalities, races, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.

POSITION BACKGROUND

Ensuring access to key medical tools is critical to MSF's Social Mission. MSF has been engaged in a wide variety of ways to improve the access situation over the past decades through the vehicle of the Access Campaign. In 2023, MSF’s International General Assembly unanimously voted a Vision that is anchoring addressing Access to Products Healthcare as being integral to its Social Mission:

“Over the coming decade, MSF will pursue and accentuate its activities aimed at delivering tangible improvements in Access to Products for Healthcare for people who are deprived of them. Whilst our actions will be as specific to operational contexts as possible, they will also be as global as necessary to achieve the specific improvements sought. This work will expose and address problems faced by patients and by operational teams, will involve the mobilization of the entire movement towards common ambitions, and will leverage the potential of partnerships. It will also preserve space for innovation and reflect the multiple expressions of our social mission. These activities will be in-depth, diverse in nature and adequately resourced, and we will learn from their successes and failures. These ambitions will be reflected in how we structure and govern this work.”

Médecins Sans Frontières works tirelessly to improve the accessibility, availability, affordability, appropriateness and quality of products for health care for the populations it assists and their communities. While this is a collective effort across the organisation, the MSF Access team plays a central role as it identifies and implements a priority selection of access projects, offers expert support for access activities elsewhere in MSF, and brings together information and analysis relevant to MSF’s access work. The MSF Access team, overseen by an Executive Board, is based around five regional hubs: Kuala Lumpur, Nairobi, Brussels, Dakar and Rio de Janeiro.

PLACE IN THE ORGANISATION

The Executive Director (ED) will be accountable to the MSF Access Executive Board for the proper oversight and management of the MSF Access resources and the execution of MSF Access’s mandate.

PURPOSE OF THE POSITION

The ED is responsible for the overall strategic, institutional, and representational leadership of MSF Access. The focus of the ED’s role will be on shepherding the vision, strategy, management, external engagement of MSF Access. Working closely with the Deputy Executive Director (DED), the ED focuses on strategic direction, high-level external representation and engagement, and internal governance and institutional management while the DED ensures medical relevance, rigour and operational grounding.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

The Executive Director’s primary responsibilities will include:

Strategic Leadership, Governance and Accountability

  • Implementation of the strategy vision of MSF Access

  • Leading development, implementation, monitoring and periodic revision of the MSF Access Strategic Plan by means of the annual/multi-year plan and budget

  • Executive leadership of the MSF Access team, including management of the MSF Access management team alongside the Deputy Executive Director

  • Final responsibility for, ongoing engagement with and reporting on the strategic progress, performance, annual budgets and expenditures, and risk mitigation strategies of MSF Access to the Executive Board, and when necessary, other MSF leadership and decision-making platforms such as the Full Executive Committee

  • Promoting processes for reflection, learning and continuous improvement across MSF Access

External Representation and Engagement

  • Representation of MSF Access in critical high-level global health and access discussions including in multilateral fora and processes, in government engagements where requested, with private sector leaders and other relevant stakeholders alongside the MSF Access MT

  • Steer MSF Access’s overall external partnership strategy in alignment with the broader MSF Access strategy and cultivate engagement with key global health and access stakeholders

Internal Leadership and Management

  • Management and coordination of key MSF Access functions (as articulated below) alongside the management team

  • Report to the MSF Access Board on key strategic and governance decisions and with informational updates of note, including but not limited to, major decisions relating to the content of MSF’s Access work, any material engagement with MSF leadership and governance structures, management of the MSF Access MT along with the DED, regular budgetary updates and accountabilities, and alongside the Head of Human Resources any HR issues requiring the attention of the board.

  • Alongside the DED and management team, translating the MSF Access Strategic Plan into annual plans for each respective body of work, including through individual projects and initiatives

  • Oversee development of MSF Access administrative policies and processes and addressing critical human resources issues

  • Development and finalization of the MSF Access annual plan and budget alongside relevant members of the management team

  • Representing MSF Access on the Medical Operational (MedOps) platform (which includes all medical directors and directors of operations across MSF) including participation in MedOps meetings as required

The ED is also responsible for ensuring that MSF Access fulfils its articulated responsibilities to the movement, which are:

  • Advise the Movement on the Common Priorities

  • Provide or source support on access issues to all entities that request it within MSF

  • Design and implement access initiatives to respond to the Common Priorities

  • Maintain an overview and report on access initiatives movement-wide on an annual basis

  • Survey and analyze the external access landscape

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 15+ years of senior management and leadership experience in global health policy, advocacy, institutional management, or humanitarian affairs

  • PhD or Master’s degree in health sciences (medical, (bio)medical, pharmacy) or international relations, public policy, public administration, public health with significant experience working in and knowledge of global health and access issues.

  • Demonstrated experience in global health and access issues in a broad range of subjects relevant to MSF’s medical humanitarian mission and operations.

  • Deep understanding of MSF’s operational and medical nature and its medical humanitarian mission.

  • Advanced managerial capabilities and experience with excellent project management capabilities, multidisciplinary teams and ability to work effectively and independently in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experience in developing and maintaining professional relationships with a wide range of stakeholders and organizations, including government officials, multilateral representatives, medical professionals, civil society, community organizations, academia, and global health donor organizations.

  • Experience in strategy development processes and demonstrated strategic thinking capabilities.

  • Proven track record of external engagements and external representation; ability to actively participate in public speaking engagements, including—but not limited to—presenting at conferences, conducting print and broadcast media interviews, and representation in external meetings.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

At MSF, we are committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, nationalities, races, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.

MSF is committed to preventing abuse, inappropriate behaviour, lack of integrity and financial misconduct in its work and care spaces. MSF expects all staff to share this commitment and promote an environment where abuse and misconduct is not tolerated.

We are committed to removing barriers for people with specific accessibility needs. If you need an adjustment to the recruitment process to be considered for the role, please let us know from the beginning of the selection process.

Note: All offers of employment will be subject to reference checks and to appropriate screening checks. By submitting an application, the job applicant confirms his/her/their understanding of these recruitment procedures.
